## DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE
**Concept:** EMA (EMA)
**Domain:** Trading Systems / indicator
**Knowledge quality:** Source-backed (source_backed)
**Source:** local

### Meaning
Exponentially weighted moving average; alpha=2/(N+1) for span N; needs warmup of N bars.

### When to use
Trend filtering and signal gating on price series; require identical bar semantics in backtest and live.

### Requirements
- Clear ownership of EMA in the architecture

### Implementation strategies
- Single source of truth for bar timestamps
- Shared calculator for sim/live

### Risks
- Lookahead bias
- Backtest/live divergence
- O(n) per recompute on large universes if not vectorized

### Performance risks
- O(n) per recompute on large universes if not vectorized

### Failure modes
- Signals on NaN indicators
- Fill model mismatch vs live

### Verification
- Fixture compare vs reference
- Warmup bar count
- No lookahead at signal time
- Parity test on fixed bar stream
- Compare to reference implementation

### Testing
- Unit tests on indicator fixtures
- Paper/backtest reconciliation

### References
- https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/reference/api/pandas.Series.ewm.html

### Repository roles
- Must inspect: django/core/checks/registry.py, django/db/models/signals.py, django/apps/registry.py, django/middleware/csrf.py, django/tasks/signals.py
- Likely modify: n/a

plan.domain_prompt_section:
## DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE
**Concept:** EMA (EMA)
**Domain:** Trading Systems / indicator
**Knowledge quality:** Source-backed (source_backed)
**Source:** local

### Meaning
Exponentially weighted moving average; alpha=2/(N+1) for span N; needs warmup of N bars.

### When to use
Trend filtering and signal gating on price series; require identical bar semantics in backtest and live.

### Requirements
- Clear ownership of EMA in the architecture

### Implementation strategies
- Single source of truth for bar timestamps
- Shared calculator for sim/live

### Risks
- Lookahead bias
- Backtest/live divergence
- O(n) per recompute on large universes if not vectorized

### Performance risks
- O(n) per recompute on large universes if not vectorized

### Failure modes
- Signals on NaN indicators
- Fill model mismatch vs live

### Verification
- Fixture compare vs reference
- Warmup bar count
- No lookahead at signal time
- Parity test on fixed bar stream
- Compare to reference implementation

### Testing
- Unit tests on indicator fixtures
- Paper/backtest reconciliation

### References
- https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/reference/api/pandas.Series.ewm.html

## DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE
**Concept:** EMA (EMA)
**Domain:** Trading Systems / indicator
**Knowledge quality:** Source-backed (source_backed)
**Source:** local

### Meaning
Exponentially weighted moving average; alpha=2/(N+1) for span N; needs warmup of N bars.

### When to use
Trend filtering and signal gating on price series; require identical bar semantics in backtest and live.

### Requirements
- Clear ownership of EMA in the architecture

### Implementation strategies
- Single source of truth for bar timestamps
- Shared calculator for sim/live

### Risks
- Lookahead bias
- Backtest/live divergence
- O(n) per recompute on large universes if not vectorized

### Performance risks
- O(n) per recompute on large universes if not vectorized

### Failure modes
- Signals on NaN indicators
- Fill model mismatch vs live

### Verification
- Fixture compare vs reference
- Warmup bar count
- No lookahead at signal time
- Parity test on fixed bar stream
- Compare to reference implementation

### Testing
- Unit tests on indicator fixtures
- Paper/backtest reconciliation

### References
- https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/reference/api/pandas.Series.ewm.html

### Repository roles
- Must inspect: django/core/checks/registry.py, django/db/models/signals.py, django/apps/registry.py, django/db/backends/sqlite3/schema.py, django/tasks/signals.py

## DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE
**Concept:** EMA (EMA)
**Domain:** Trading Systems / indicator
**Knowledge quality:** Source-backed (source_backed)
**Source:** local

### Meaning
Exponentially weighted moving average; alpha=2/(N+1) for span N; needs warmup of N bars.

### When to use
Trend filtering and signal gating on price series; require identical bar semantics in backtest and live.

### Requirements
- Clear ownership of EMA in the architecture

### Implementation strategies
- Single source of truth for bar timestamps
- Shared calculator for sim/live

### Risks
- Lookahead bias
- Backtest/live divergence
- O(n) per recompute on large universes if not vectorized

### Performance risks
- O(n) per recompute on large universes if not vectorized

### Failure modes
- Signals on NaN indicators
- Fill model mismatch vs live

### Verification
- Fixture compare vs reference
- Warmup bar count
- No lookahead at signal time
- Parity test on fixed bar stream
- Compare to reference implementation

### Testing
- Unit tests on indicator fixtures
- Paper/backtest reconciliation

### References
- https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/reference/api/pandas.Series.ewm.html

## DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE
**Concept:** EMA (EMA)
**Domain:** Trading Systems / indicator
**Knowledge quality:** Source-backed (source_backed)
**Source:** local

### Meaning
Exponentially weighted moving average; alpha=2/(N+1) for span N; needs warmup of N bars.

### When to use
Trend filtering and signal gating on price series; require identical bar semantics in backtest and live.

### Requirements
- Clear ownership of EMA in the architecture

### Implementation strategies
- Single source of truth for bar timestamps
- Shared calculator for sim/live

### Risks
- Lookahead bias
- Backtest/live divergence
- O(n) per recompute on large universes if not vectorized

### Performance risks
- O(n) per recompute on large universes if not vectorized

### Failure modes
- Signals on NaN indicators
- Fill model mismatch vs live

### Verification
- Fixture compare vs reference
- Warmup bar count
- No lookahead at signal time
- Parity test on fixed bar stream
- Compare to reference implementation

### Testing
- Unit tests on indicator fixtures
- Paper/backtest reconciliation

### References
- https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/reference/api/pandas.Series.ewm.html

## Symptom
why is template rendering metrics broken


## DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE
**Concept:** EMA (EMA)
**Domain:** Trading Systems / indicator
**Knowledge quality:** Source-backed (source_backed)
**Source:** local

### Meaning
Exponentially weighted moving average; alpha=2/(N+1) for span N; needs warmup of N bars.

### When to use
Trend filtering and signal gating on price series; require identical bar semantics in backtest and live.

### Requirements
- Clear ownership of EMA in the architecture

### Implementation strategies
- Single source of truth for bar timestamps
- Shared calculator for sim/live

### Risks
- Lookahead bias
- Backtest/live divergence
- O(n) per recompute on large universes if not vectorized

### Performance risks
- O(n) per recompute on large universes if not vectorized

### Failure modes
- Signals on NaN indicators
- Fill model mismatch vs live

### Verification
- Fixture compare vs reference
- Warmup bar count
- No lookahead at signal time
- Parity test on fixed bar stream
- Compare to reference implementation

### Testing
- Unit tests on indicator fixtures
- Paper/backtest reconciliation

### References
- https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/reference/api/pandas.Series.ewm.html

django.utils.text.smart_split() in `django/contrib/admin/options.py`

- How to disprove: Bypass the cache and re-query; same value ⇒ cache is not stale.

- Why it fits: The display layer reads the wrong key or applies wrong formatting/units.
- Files: django/db/models/functions/uuid.py, django/contrib/auth/views.py, django/contrib/admindocs/views.py, django/contrib/admin/views/autocomplete.py, django/contrib/sitemaps/views.py
- Should be true if correct: The API response value equals what the widget renders.
- How to disprove: Compare the raw API payload to the rendered number; equal ⇒ UI binding is fine.

**Concept:** EMA (EMA)
**Domain:** Trading Systems / indicator
**Knowledge quality:** Source-backed (source_backed)
**Source:** local

### Meaning
Exponentially weighted moving average; alpha=2/(N+1) for span N; needs warmup of N bars.

### When to use
Trend filtering and signal gating on price series; require identical bar semantics in backtest and live.

### Requirements
- Clear ownership of EMA in the architecture

### Implementation strategies
- Single source of truth for bar timestamps
- Shared calculator for sim/live

### Risks
- Lookahead bias
- Backtest/live divergence
- O(n) per recompute on large universes if not vectorized

### Performance risks
- O(n) per recompute on large universes if not vectorized

### Failure modes
- Signals on NaN indicators
- Fill model mismatch vs live

- Fixture compare vs reference
- Warmup bar count
- No lookahead at signal time
- Parity test on fixed bar stream
- Compare to reference implementation

### Testing
- Unit tests on indicator fixtures
- Paper/backtest reconciliation

- https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/reference/api/pandas.Series.ewm.html

## DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE
**Concept:** EMA (EMA)
**Domain:** Trading Systems / indicator
**Knowledge quality:** Source-backed (source_backed)
**Source:** local

### Meaning
Exponentially weighted moving average; alpha=2/(N+1) for span N; needs warmup of N bars.

### When to use
Trend filtering and signal gating on price series; require identical bar semantics in backtest and live.

### Requirements
- Clear ownership of EMA in the architecture

### Implementation strategies
- Single source of truth for bar timestamps
- Shared calculator for sim/live

### Risks
- Lookahead bias
- Backtest/live divergence
- O(n) per recompute on large universes if not vectorized

### Performance risks
- O(n) per recompute on large universes if not vectorized

### Failure modes
- Signals on NaN indicators
- Fill model mismatch vs live

### Verification
- Fixture compare vs reference
- Warmup bar count
- No lookahead at signal time
- Parity test on fixed bar stream
- Compare to reference implementation

### Testing
- Unit tests on indicator fixtures
- Paper/backtest reconciliation

### References
- https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/reference/api/pandas.Series.ewm.html

Exponentially weighted moving average; alpha=2/(N+1) for span N; needs warmup of N bars.

## DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE
**Concept:** EMA (EMA)
**Domain:** Trading Systems / indicator
**Knowledge quality:** Source-backed (source_backed)
**Source:** local

### Meaning
Exponentially weighted moving average; alpha=2/(N+1) for span N; needs warmup of N bars.

### When to use
Trend filtering and signal gating on price series; require identical bar semantics in backtest and live.

### Requirements
- Clear ownership of EMA in the architecture

### Implementation strategies
- Single source of truth for bar timestamps
- Shared calculator for sim/live

### Risks
- Lookahead bias
- Backtest/live divergence
- O(n) per recompute on large universes if not vectorized

### Performance risks
- O(n) per recompute on large universes if not vectorized

### Failure modes
- Signals on NaN indicators
- Fill model mismatch vs live

### Verification
- Fixture compare vs reference
- Warmup bar count
- No lookahead at signal time
- Parity test on fixed bar stream
- Compare to reference implementation

### Testing
- Unit tests on indicator fixtures
- Paper/backtest reconciliation

### References
- https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/reference/api/pandas.Series.ewm.html

**Concept:** EMA (EMA)
**Domain:** Trading Systems / indicator
**Knowledge quality:** Source-backed (source_backed)
**Source:** local

### Meaning
Exponentially weighted moving average; alpha=2/(N+1) for span N; needs warmup of N bars.

### When to use
Trend filtering and signal gating on price series; require identical bar semantics in backtest and live.

### Requirements
- Clear ownership of EMA in the architecture

### Implementation strategies
- Single source of truth for bar timestamps
- Shared calculator for sim/live

### Risks
- Lookahead bias
- Backtest/live divergence
- O(n) per recompute on large universes if not vectorized

### Performance risks
- O(n) per recompute on large universes if not vectorized

### Failure modes
- Signals on NaN indicators
- Fill model mismatch vs live

### Verification
- Fixture compare vs reference
- Warmup bar count
- No lookahead at signal time
- Parity test on fixed bar stream
- Compare to reference implementation

### Testing
- Unit tests on indicator fixtures
- Paper/backtest reconciliation

### References
- https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/reference/api/pandas.Series.ewm.html

- Compare to reference implementation

### Testing
- Unit tests on indicator fixtures
- Paper/backtest reconciliation

### References
